correctness.rationale: For iid uniform cell labels Z_a, C=sum_{a<b}1[Z_a=Z_b] and X²=m−n+(2m/n)C. By pair exchangeability Cov(C,T_h)=choose(n,2)Cov(I12,T_h). Conditioning on pair collision versus distinct cells gives E[T_h|I=1]−E[T_h|I=0]=E[h(Y+2)−2h(Y+1)+h(Y)], Y~Bin(n−2,1/m). Cov(I,T_h)=(m−1)/m² times that, obtaining coefficient (n−1)(m−1)/m. For D_lambda, the sign of prefactor cancels convexity reversal across lambda=0, so covariance>0 all lambda>−1. For G², discrete convex f(k)=k log k, n E Δ²f(Y)→m, giving 2(m−1) limit; tail bounds justify interchange. Exhaustively independently enumerated sample label sequences and confirmed 60 covariance identities. The m,n≥2 and empty-cell conventions verified.
